title: Move official KiCad libraries as one coherent Release Set
rationale: Symbols, footprints, and 3D packages move together at one compatible release tag and exact commits. Prefer adopting a coherent system installation read-only, and do not invent an exact tag when local provenance cannot prove it.

title: Never use editable working copies as installed releases
rationale: Fetch and validate exact revisions in staging, install releases immutably, and activate through an atomic pointer or configuration change with rollback. Never check out another tag in place beneath KiCad; defer activation whenever editor cleanliness cannot be proven.

title: Keep library resolution behind one deep module boundary
rationale: Callers provide selection intent. LibraryResolver owns matching, external-reference detection, copy-to-local policy, namespace handling, associated 3D assets, warnings, and stable local references. UI screens must not duplicate KiCad file orchestration; the boundary survives the Rust migration even though the implementation language changes.
